meta.notes: Chronicle templates (iter-0c draft, completed in iter-5 with the renderer). Tone per MVP_SCOPE §12: no LLM, no embellishment — the readability test (T7) runs on exactly this output. Syntax: {slot} binds event data (actor/target/location/t/outcome fields); #symbol# expands the tracery grammar (render/tracery.py — modifiers .a/.capitalize/.upper/.lower); {cond?a|b} is ink-style conditional text on a raw context value; [key:value] saves an expansion for the rest of the line. Lists = alternatives picked via the ink-shuffle ShufflePool (no immediate repeat, cosmetic stream). tale_gate.min_importance decides which events earn a chronicle line at all (MVP_SCOPE §9); tune-1 (iter-27) raised it low—medium: the importance rule now hooks story-critical events (rules.json importance.story_critical_events, D-045(b)/D-059), so medium separates the tale's beats from the per-beat axis bookkeeping (status_decayed/suspicion_changed) and world texture (wait/move/look) — the rule owns the split, the gate follows.

events.examine_failed: {actor} squints at {target}, unsure what to make of it.
events.take_failed: {target?{actor} reaches for {target} — and is noticed.|{actor} reaches for the {texture_slot} — and is noticed.}
events.pickpocket_failed: {actor}'s hand drifts toward {target}'s purse — {target} notices the movement.
events.smoke_rising: Smoke fills {location}; it is getting hard to see.
events.location_burned_out: {location} burns out. Nothing will be the same here.
events.watch_change: {outgoing?The watch changes: {outgoing} hands the post to {incoming}.|The watch changes: {incoming} takes the post.}
events.arrest_resolved: {caught?{target} is caught — the pursuit holds.|{target} slips away.}
events.expectation_violation: {actor} checks on {target} — it is not where it should be.
